title: Accountability in Foreign Animal Research Act
latestAction: Referred to the House Committee on Energy and Commerce.
summary:
Accountability in Foreign Animal Research Act

This bill prohibits the Department of Health and Human Services from conducting or supporting biomedical research or experimentation on vertebrate animals in a facility or through an entity that is located in or affiliated with China, Iran, North Korea, Russia, or another foreign country of concern.
